activity.role: Commander of the French Ninth Army
activity.notes: Appointed after the German Meuse breakthrough 15 May 1940 and taken prisoner near Wassigny 18 May 1940. Ninth Army, NOT another 7th Army second stint. Same-day terminal denotes capture, not free resignation.

sources.title: Fondation Charles de Gaulle — Henri GIRAUD
sources.citation_text: Giraud Third Army 1936, Seventh Army 1939, Ninth Army after 15 May 1940, prisoner on May 18, North Africa civil-military command late 1942, CFLN copresidency 3 June to early Oct 1943, general commander in chief ending 4 April 1944, Superior War Council 1949.
